# StaneAI

> StaneAI (StaneAI Private Limited, also written "Stane AI") is an Indian AI and software products company founded in 2026. It builds mobile apps for Android and iOS, AI and workflow automation, AI chatbots and custom software for startups and small and growing businesses in India and the United States. Website: https://staneai.in

Key facts:

- Legal name: StaneAI Private Limited
- Founded: 2026
- Country: India; works with clients in India and the United States
- Focus: mobile applications (Android and iOS), AI automation, AI chatbots, custom software
- Approach: product-led, AI-enabled, mobile-first; builds focused MVPs first, then improves them with real user feedback
- Languages: English and Hindi
- Contact: contact@staneai.in (new projects), support@staneai.in (support)
- Tagline: "Ideas into intelligent products."

## About

- [About StaneAI](https://staneai.in/about/): who we are, what we build, how we work, company details

## Services

- [Mobile App Development](https://staneai.in/mobile-app-development/): Android and iOS apps, cross-platform (Flutter / React Native) and native, from MVP to launch
- [AI & Workflow Automation](https://staneai.in/ai-automation/): automating repetitive business tasks with AI and integrations
- [AI Chatbot Development](https://staneai.in/ai-chatbot-development/): customer-support and business chatbots built on company knowledge
- [Software Development](https://staneai.in/software-development/): custom web software, dashboards and internal tools

## Guides

- [Mobile app development in India: the complete guide for businesses](https://staneai.in/blog/mobile-app-development-guide-india/): Everything to plan, build and launch an app in India: platforms, technology, MVP, cost, partners, payments, privacy and store launch.
- [AI for business: the complete guide for Indian companies](https://staneai.in/blog/ai-for-business-guide-india/): Where AI helps and where it does not, build vs buy, privacy, accuracy, costs, ROI and a step-by-step plan to start.
- [App maintenance cost in India: what to budget after launch](https://staneai.in/blog/app-maintenance-cost-india/): What maintenance covers, the yearly OS and store updates you cannot skip, running costs, and how to plan a realistic yearly budget.
- [Hiring an app development team in India: a guide for US startups](https://staneai.in/blog/hire-app-developers-india/): Engagement models, time-zone overlap, contracts and IP ownership, payments and the red flags to watch for when you work with an Indian team.
- [How to publish your app on Google Play and the App Store](https://staneai.in/blog/publish-app-google-play-app-store/): Developer accounts, fees, testing rules, store listings, privacy forms and review: a step-by-step launch checklist for Android and iOS.
- [Website or mobile app: which does your business need first?](https://staneai.in/blog/website-vs-mobile-app/): Compare reach, cost, features and upkeep, then use a simple checklist to decide whether to start with a website, a web app or a mobile app.

- [How long does it take to build a mobile app?](https://staneai.in/blog/how-long-to-build-a-mobile-app/)
